biology.title: Basic Information
bulletPoints: Biological category (e.g. transcription factor, kinase, RBP) and significance
Structure: PDB ID, solved structures, domains, oligomerization state
Family members and cross-species homology
Other biochemical / biophysical properties
bulletPointsZh: 生物学类别描述（如转录因子、激酶、RBP 等）及其意义
结构：PDB ID、已解析结构、结构域、寡聚化状态
家族成员及跨物种同源性
其他生化 / 生物物理属性

biology.title: Expression Pattern
bulletPoints: Organ / cell type / sub-cellular expression (intensity & location; focus on protein level and clinically relevant studies)
Expression during development, homeostasis, and disease states; attention to on-target, off-tissue toxicity potential
Differential expression across model organisms (if relevant)
bulletPointsZh: 器官 / 细胞类型 / 亚细胞表达（强度与定位；重点关注蛋白水平和临床相关研究）
发育、稳态与疾病状态下的表达；关注 on-target、off-tissue 毒性潜力
跨模式生物的差异表达（如适用）

biology.title: Biological Functions
bulletPoints: Biological functions and corresponding domains (enzymatic activity, inhibitory PPI, etc.)
Interacting partners, molecular pathways, and downstream targets
bulletPointsZh: 生物学功能及对应结构域（酶活性、抑制性 PPI 等）
互作伙伴、分子通路和下游靶标

biology.title: Biological Regulation at Various Levels
bulletPoints: Transcriptional & post-transcriptional regulation
Translational & post-translational regulation
Protein degradation regulation
bulletPointsZh: 转录与转录后调控
翻译与翻译后调控
蛋白降解调控

biology.title: Special Highlights
bulletPoints: Isoforms; structurally / domain-similar protein targets
Regulatory phosphorylation sites, translocation sites
Cofactors required for function / interactions
bulletPointsZh: 同工型；结构 / 结构域相似蛋白靶点
调控性磷酸化位点、转位位点
功能 / 互作所需辅因子

disease.title: Participation & Contribution in Disease
disease.titleZh: 靶点在疾病中的参与与贡献
bulletPoints: Role in signaling pathways; sole regulator vs. network / backup regulators
Regulation of other proteins; functional complex vs. independent
Role in stabilization of other macromolecules
bulletPointsZh: 在信号通路中的作用；单一核心调节者还是多重 / 备份调节网络的一部分
对其他蛋白的调控；属于功能复合体还是相对独立发挥作用
对其他大分子稳定性的影响

disease.title: Dysregulations Contributing to Disease Manifestation
disease.titleZh: 促成疾病表型的异常失调
bulletPoints: Mutations
Constitutive activation / deactivation
Alternative splicing / isoforms / post-transcriptional modifications (disease vs. normal)
Upregulation
bulletPointsZh: 突变
构成性激活 / 失活
可变剪接 / 同工型 / 转录后修饰（疾病与正常状态对比）
上调表达

disease.title: Evidences for Disease-Causing Mechanisms
bulletPoints: In vitro / in vivo data directly confirming disease-causing mechanism
Human genetic evidence (selection of biomarkers, change in tumor size, direct/indirect mechanism)
Effectiveness of specific targeting(existence of functional isoform, non-canonical activation, PTM) and on-target, off-tissue effect, off-target effect (similar sequence/degron/structure)
Loss-of-function / gain-of-function studies
bulletPointsZh: 直接验证致病机制的体外 / 体内数据
人体遗传学证据（生物标志物选择、肿瘤体积变化、直接/间接机制）
特异性靶向有效性（是否存在功能性同工型、非经典激活、PTM）以及 on-target、off-tissue 影响和 off-target 影响（相似序列/degron/结构）
失功能 / 获功能研究

disease.title: Indications to Cover in This Review
disease.titleZh: 本报告应覆盖的适应症
bulletPoints: Table: Indication / Target Significance / Target Dysregulation / LoF-GoF studies
bulletPointsZh: 表格：适应症 / 靶点意义 / 靶点失调 / LoF-GoF 研究

disease.title: Druggability
bulletPoints: Protein structure & presence of druggable pockets
Contribution to disease axes (i.e. singular regulator vs multiple/backup regulators, part of large complex vs functional independent, etc)
Druggable window (expression intensity and location specificities, gene/protein modifications)
Effectiveness of specific targeting (existence of functional isoform, non-canonical activation) and off-target effect (similar sequence/degron/structure)
Existing and proposed treatment strategies (single inhibition vs in combination with inhibitors up/downstream, against drug resistant cell lines)
bulletPointsZh: 蛋白结构与可成药口袋
对疾病轴的贡献（即单一调节者 vs 多重/备份调节者，大型复合体成员 vs 功能相对独立等）
可成药窗口（表达强度和定位特异性、基因/蛋白修饰）
特异性靶向有效性（是否存在功能性同工型、非经典激活）及 off-target 影响（相似序列/degron/结构）
现有与拟议治疗策略（单药抑制 vs 与上下游抑制剂联合，用于耐药细胞系）

disease.title: [Indication X] Target-Disease Axes Overview
disease.titleZh: [适应症 X]靶点-疾病轴概览
bulletPoints: For each indication included, summarize clinical treatment guidelines (at least include US)
For each indication included, identify the effectiveness and safety profile of current SoC and key emerging treatment as benchmark;
Briefly re-visit the target significance & dysregulation/disease-causing MoA in each indication included.
bulletPointsZh: 针对每个纳入适应症，总结临床治疗指南（至少包含美国）
针对每个纳入适应症，识别当前 SoC 和关键新兴疗法的有效性与安全性特征作为 benchmark；
简要回顾各纳入适应症下的靶点重要性、失调情况/致病 MoA。

disease.title: [Indication X] Clinical Development Path & Criteria
disease.titleZh: [适应症 X]临床开发路径与标准
bulletPoints: Phase 1 / 2 / 3 table: participants, study design, timeline, surrogate & primary endpoints, key PD/PK markers, control agent selection
bulletPointsZh: I/II/III 期表格：受试者、研究设计、时间线、替代终点与主要终点、关键 PD/PK 标志物、对照药物选择

disease.title: [Indication X] Development Strategy & Competitive Edge
disease.titleZh: [适应症 X]开发策略与竞争优势
bulletPoints: Major unmet medical needs (non-responders, patient compliance, etc.)

Position of pipeline against the target with current SoC / emerging treatment (possibility of combined treatment regime? Different patient population? Better single Tx efficacy / safety / convenience?)
Contributing MoA of above strategy (MoA with an angle on product development: why such target approach / candidate can yield e.g. better efficacy)
bulletPointsZh: 主要未满足临床需求（非应答人群、依从性等）
靶向该靶点的管线相对当前 SoC / 新兴疗法的定位（是否可能联合治疗？不同患者人群？更好的单药疗效 / 安全性 / 便利性？）
上述策略的 MoA 贡献（从产品开发角度解释该 MoA：为什么这种靶点策略 / 候选物可带来例如更好疗效）

competition.title: Pipeline Overview
bulletPoints: Table: Pipeline / Sponsor / TA / MoA / Format / Developmental Status / Notable Events
Include only asset-specific notable events: terminated programs (reason), licensing & deal info, regulatory milestones (BTD, approval, etc.) must explicitly name the pipeline/asset in that row
bulletPointsZh: 表格：管线 / 发起方 / TA / MoA / 形式 / 开发状态 / 重要事件
只写与该行管线/分子直接相关的重要事件：终止原因、授权/交易、监管里程碑等证据必须明确点名该管线/分子

competition.title: MoA Category Deep-Dives [repeat per MoA]
competition.titleZh: MoA 分类深挖（按 MoA 重复）
bulletPoints: Current MoA overview: description, representative pipelines, and why this MoA matters for the target
Pros / cons and key development constraints for this MoA
Mechanism illustration: generate and insert a schematic only when evidence supports the mechanism
Navigation cue: downstream pages cover preclinical metrics, clinical metrics, and detailed drug profiles for this MoA
bulletPointsZh: 当前 MoA 总览：机制描述、代表性管线，以及该 MoA 对本靶点的重要性
该 MoA 的优缺点和关键开发限制
机制图：仅在证据支持时生成并插入机制示意图
结构提示：后续页面围绕该 MoA 展开临床前指标、临床指标和详细疗法档案

competition.title: MoA Overview
bulletPoints: Brief description or illustration of MoA
Pros / Cons
bulletPointsZh: 作用机制的简要描述或示意
优劣势

competition.title: Pipelines with Newer MoA / Modalities  (if applicable)
competition.titleZh: 新机制 / 新模态管线（如适用）
bulletPoints: Types of modalities, structures, indications
How different are the MoAs
Advantages and disadvantages of new MoA and/or modalities
In vitro/in vivo data for comparison with existing/in-clinical trial products
Tox, ADME and efficacy studies
PD/PK biomarkers, if there are any differences?
bulletPointsZh: 模态类型、结构特征、适应症
这些 MoA 的差异程度
新 MoA 和 / 或新模态的优势与劣势
用于对比已有/临床试验中产品的体外/体内数据
毒理、ADME 和疗效研究
PD/PK 生物标志物，如有，是否存在差异？

competition.title: Pipelines Indirectly Affecting the Target  (if applicable)
competition.titleZh: 间接影响靶点的管线（如适用）
bulletPoints: Drug info, structures, patents, indications
MoA of indirect regulation of target expression / modification
Preclinical & clinical data; potential drug-drug interactions
bulletPointsZh: 药物信息、结构、专利、适应症
间接调控靶点表达 / 修饰的作用机制
临床前与临床数据；潜在药物相互作用

preclinical.title: Key Preclinical Metrics
bulletPoints: Overview table: affinity (KD), in-vitro IC50, cell assay EC50, in-vivo dose, in-vivo T1/2
LLM-selected key preclinical metrics: biochemical / enzymatic IC50, functional assay EC50 readout, animal model and therapeutic readout, and key in vivo biomarkers
Per-pipeline preclinical summary, in vitro data, and in vivo data; missing numeric metrics must remain N/A
bulletPointsZh: 概览表：亲和力（KD）、体外 IC50、细胞实验 EC50、体内剂量、体内 T1/2
LLM 推荐关键临床前指标：生化 / 酶学 IC50、功能实验 EC50 readout、动物模型与治疗 readout、关键体内生物标志物
按管线总结临床前概况、体外数据和体内数据；缺失数值必须保留为 N/A

preclinical.title: Structure / Binding Data
bulletPoints: Only when structure or binding evidence exists: summarize the key structure / binding / mechanism figure-supported findings for the current recommended pipeline
Describe what the figure shows and the takeaway, not the full experimental procedure
bulletPointsZh: 仅在存在结构或结合证据时：总结当前推荐管线最关键的结构 / 结合 / 机制图证据及结论
重点写图能支持的发现与意义，不展开完整实验过程

preclinical.title: In Vivo Data
bulletPoints: Summarize the strongest in vivo efficacy / PD / safety-supporting findings for the current recommended pipeline
Group related animal studies and figures on the same slide when they support the same conclusion
If no figure exists, use the structured model / treatment / measurement results to support the conclusion briefly
bulletPointsZh: 总结当前推荐管线最关键的体内药效 / PD / 安全性支持证据
同一结论下的相关动物实验与图片尽量合并到同一页展示
如果没有图片，则用结构化的模型 / 给药设计 / measurement results 做简洁补充说明

preclinical.title: In Vitro Data
bulletPoints: Summarize the strongest in vitro / cellular findings for the current recommended pipeline
Batch related figures and readouts together when they support one mechanistic or efficacy conclusion
If no figure exists, use the structured model / treatment / measurement results to support the conclusion briefly
bulletPointsZh: 总结当前推荐管线最关键的体外 / 细胞实验发现
当多张图或多个 readout 共同支撑一个机制或药效结论时，聚合在同一页展示
如果没有图片，则用结构化的模型 / 给药设计 / measurement results 做简洁补充说明

clinical.title: Key Clinical Metrics
bulletPoints: Overview table: indication / highest stage, data stage, cohorts, design, patient baseline, primary endpoints
Key AE profile, dosing scheme, control agent selection, PD markers, PK metrics, and annual sales (if marketed)
Per-pipeline clinical metrics summary
bulletPointsZh: 概览表：适应症 / 最高阶段、数据阶段、队列、设计、患者基线、主要终点
关键 AE 特征、给药方案、对照药物选择、PD 标志物、PK 指标及年销售额（如已上市）
按管线总结临床指标

insights.title: [MoA1] For Marketed & Clinical-Stage Therapeutics
bulletPoints: Basic info: structure, design rationale, patent, market size, line of treatment, formulation / dosing
Preclinical data: in vitro / in vivo effect, Tox, ADME, efficacy, CMC
Clinical data by trial: stage, indication, design, endpoints, efficacy, safety, PK/PD biomarkers
Cross-trial comparison (efficacy trend across stages, across indications)
For clinical-stage: comparison with current market-leading therapy; concomitant / combination therapy
bulletPointsZh: 基础信息：结构、设计逻辑、专利、市场规模、治疗线别、剂型 / 给药方式
临床前数据：体外 / 体内效果、毒理、ADME、疗效、CMC
逐试验临床数据：阶段、适应症、设计、终点、疗效、安全性、PK/PD 生物标志物
跨试验比较（跨阶段、跨适应症的疗效趋势）
对于临床阶段：与当前市场主导疗法对比；伴随 / 联合治疗

insights.title: Key Limitations of Existing Therapeutics / Pipelines
insights.titleZh: 现有疗法 / 管线的关键局限
bulletPoints: Formulation & CMC aspects (if applicable)
Efficacy aspects (if applicable)
Safety aspects (if applicable)
Patient compliance (if applicable)
Others
bulletPointsZh: 制剂与 CMC 局限（如适用）
疗效局限（如适用）
安全性局限（如适用）
患者依从性问题（如适用）
其他限制因素

insights.title: Risks & Knowledge Gaps
bulletPoints: Risks
Biology-related (e.g. on-target toxicity)
Disease-related (e.g. change of treatment paradigm)
Market-related (e.g. competition from newly emerging targets)
Knowledge Gaps
Critical information that is currently lacking
Causal relationships that what we don’t understand (e.g. next-gen compound failed in trial, and we cannot dissect out the root cause from public data)
bulletPointsZh: 风险
生物学相关（如 on-target 毒性）
疾病相关（如治疗范式变化）
市场相关（如新兴竞争靶点带来的竞争）
知识空白
当前缺失的关键信息
我们尚未理解的因果关系（例如下一代化合物在试验中失败，但无法从公开数据中拆解根本原因）

insights.title: Benchmarks for Best-in-Class (BIC) Candidates
bulletPoints: Table: Current BIC / Market-leading product / MoA-Format / TA-Indication / Preclinical metrics / Clinical efficacy endpoints / Clinical safety metrics / Other key metrics
Commentary on required improvements for next-generation asset
bulletPointsZh: 表格：当前 BIC / 市场领先产品 / MoA-形式 / TA-适应症 / 临床前指标 / 临床疗效终点 / 临床安全性指标 / 其他关键指标
关于下一代资产所需改进的评论

nodes.title: In Vitro Data
